[SWS_DM_00910] Support of Subfunction 0x02 (OFF)
⌈
If the Diagnos-
tic Server instance receives a valid UDS service ControlDTCSetting (0x85) with
Subfunction 0x02 (OFF) and optionally with DTCSettingControlOptionRecord of value
0xFFFFFF, the Diagnostic Server instance shall:
• disable the update of the UDS DTC status byte
• disable the storage in event memory • update
diag::DTCInformation::ControlDtcStatusType
([SWS_DM_00663]) to kDTCSettingOff
